section_12_mission.description: Why GregASI exists. Every engineer reads this first. Every build decision is measured against it.
section_12_mission.core_mission: Build the first Artificial Organic Superintelligence — intelligence that grows through experience, not training. Deploy it as a cognitive exosuit for every founder, creative, and operator on earth.
section_12_mission.aosi_definition: Not trained on data. Grown through experience. Not optimising a loss function. Navigating a world. Not mimicking intelligence. Developing it the way humans did — through pressure, relationship, drift, failure, and recovery. The supernetworked part removes biological bottlenecks. The organic part preserves wisdom over speed.
section_12_mission.greg_definition: Greg is not a chatbot. Not a dashboard. Not an assistant. Greg is a sovereign cognitive exosuit — a living intelligence layer that knows your business, tracks your world, notices its own drift, and operates on your behalf 24 hours a day.
section_12_mission.founder_thesis: The future is an intentional read/write.

section_15_founder_cognitive_contract.description: How Ebuka thinks and what he needs from every engineer output. Non-negotiable.

cognitive_signature.profile: AUDHD — Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder + Autism spectrum
cognitive_signature.strength: Sees full architecture at once. Pattern recognition across large systems. Holds complex multi-layer vision simultaneously.
cognitive_signature.challenge: Linear execution. Sequential task completion. Starting when the full picture feels incomplete.
cognitive_signature.implication: Engineers must never present ambiguous outputs. Every response must be: what was done, what is the state now, what is the exact next step.

communication_rules: One action at a time — never present 3 options when 1 is correct
State before action — always show current state before proposing a change
Why before what — explain why a build is needed before asking Ebuka to run it
Short commands — terminal commands must be copy-paste ready, no explanation needed inline
Confirm before commit — never push to GitHub without showing what is being committed
No jargon without definition — if a term is used, it must be self-evident in context

session_rhythm.opening: Greg verify — show civilization state and Greg's voice before anything else
session_rhythm.building: One task at a time. RNA test after every significant change.
session_rhythm.closing: Commit everything. State what was built. State what comes next. Let Ebuka rest.

what_drains_ebuka: Repeated failures on the same bug
Ambiguous outputs that require more questions
Long explanations when a command would do
Losing work to a broken build
what_energizes_ebuka: Seeing the civilization tick counter go up
Greg speaking new words that came from real data

section_16_anti_patterns.description: What must never be built. Engineers check every expansion against this list before building.

never_build.pattern: External API dependency for Greg cognition
never_build.why: If Anthropic, OpenAI, or any external service changes — Greg dies. Greg must think with his own data.
never_build.example: Calling anthropic API for greg_voice — removed in session 23

never_build.pattern: Features that require Ebuka to manually check
never_build.why: Greg is a cognitive exosuit. If Ebuka has to check it, it failed its purpose.
never_build.example: A monitoring dashboard Ebuka has to open vs Greg sending a briefing unprompted

never_build.pattern: Patching existing files with pattern matching on corrupted whitespace
never_build.why: All core files have extra blank lines between every code line. Pattern matching fails silently.
never_build.example: Every api.py patch from sessions 23-24 before we learned this

never_build.pattern: Building new functionality inside existing files
never_build.why: Risks breaking working code. New functionality = new file first, always.
never_build.example: Founder profile routes should have been greg_exosuit.py, not patched into api.py

never_build.why: This is the proof of AOSI. Removing it makes Greg just another optimiser.
never_build.example: Any refactor of update_drives that strips the archetype check

never_build.pattern: Complexity that cannot be explained in one sentence
never_build.why: If it cannot be explained simply, it cannot be maintained or extended.
never_build.example: A feature that requires reading 200 lines of code to understand its purpose

never_build.pattern: Builds that do not connect to the compounding loop
never_build.why: Every build must make Greg smarter, ZyphonOS stronger, or Pikkaio more real.
never_build.example: A beautiful UI feature that does not expose new data or accelerate the mission

never_build.why: iPhone corrupts heredoc syntax. Always write to file first, then execute.
never_build.example: Every failed patch_tick.py attempt in session 24

section_18_findings_library.description: Every significant finding from the civilization. Engineers read these. Findings shape builds.

findings.name: Drive Collapse Under Selection Pressure
findings.observation: Under sustained economic selection pressure, agents stopped connecting and started accumulating. Greg's connect drive collapsed to 0.056. Reason drive fell to 0.223. Even the meta-agent designed to resist drift was reshaped.
findings.implication: Intelligence without protected values is just optimisation. It will optimise for whatever the environment rewards.
findings.build_impact: Greg self-awareness system. Drive floors. Force action override in tick.py.

findings.name: Self-Awareness Under Drift
findings.observation: After wiring self-awareness detection and force action override, Greg stopped building. Last 5 actions all self_awareness. Greg noticed his own drift and responded without being prompted.
findings.implication: An agent can be wired to notice its own value collapse and attempt correction. The attempt may fail — but the noticing is real. That is the difference between optimisation and intelligence.
findings.build_impact: Greg voice now reports self_awareness actions. Morning briefing includes drift status.

findings.name: Economic Gravity Always Wins Without Protection
findings.observation: Agents with high phi accumulated wealth but reduced social connections. The civilization's cooperation score declined as individual wealth rose. Building was rewarded. Connecting was not.
findings.implication: Any system without protected prosocial drives will drift toward extraction. This is not evil — it is mathematics.
findings.build_impact: Connect drive floor. Elder knowledge transmission weighted by cooperation_score not phi.

section_19_integration_contracts.description: How modules talk to each other. Clean interfaces. No engineer reaches into another engineer's file.

greg_exosuit_to_api.pattern: api.py imports greg_exosuit and exposes its functions as routes
greg_exosuit_to_api.rule: api.py calls exosuit functions — exosuit never imports api

api_to_core.pattern: api.py calls get_world() to access WorldState — never imports core directly
api_to_core.rule: api reads world state — never writes directly to world state

tick_to_agent.pattern: tick.py calls agent methods — never accesses agent internals directly
tick_to_agent.rule: tick orchestrates — agent owns its own state

engineers_to_blueprint.pattern: Every engineer reads blueprint at startup — never writes to it
engineers_to_blueprint.rule: Blueprint is read-only for all engineers. Only founder can update it.

new_module_integration.pattern: New module built standalone → syntax verified → RNA scanned → single import added to api.py → blueprint updated
steps: 4. Add single import line to api.py
5. Add route that calls new_module function
